title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Standards for Acceptance Fees in Cases of Company Dissolution Disputes

articles.content_en:
September 22, 2023
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Criteria for Acceptance Fees in Cases of Company Dissolution Disputes
Fa Shi [2023] No. 9
Higher People's Court of Fujian Province:
Your Request for Instructions on the Criteria for Acceptance Fees in Cases of Company Dissolution Disputes has been received. Upon review, the Reply is as follows:
The second opinion of your Adjudication Committee is approved. Acceptance fees for company dissolution disputes shall be determined according to the standards for non-property cases. The application fee in compulsory company liquidation cases shall be calculated based on the total amount of the compulsory liquidation property, at half of the acceptance fee standard for property cases.
